metadata.name: Liberalism
metadata.description: The constitutional liberalism of Liberal International’s Oxford and Andorra manifestos, combining individual rights, representative government, market institutions and international cooperation.
metadata.scope: International constitutional liberalism in Liberal International’s Oxford (1947) and Andorra (2017) manifestos. Andorra explicitly renews Oxford; it supplies contemporary positions rather than projecting 1947 silence onto modern questions. This is the federation’s agreed doctrine, not every member government’s conduct. Unsupported empirical causal comparisons remain unresolved.
metadata.phrase: A society protecting individual rights, representative government and private enterprise within constitutional limits.
